INSERT INTO sessions (channel, user_identifier, user_type, status, dsgvo_consent, collected_data, metadata)
VALUES ('{{ $json.channel }}', '{{ $json.user_identifier }}', 'unknown', 'active', false, '{}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata || {}) }}'::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (channel, user_identifier) DO UPDATE SET
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, channel, user_identifier, user_type, status, dsgvo_consent, collected_data, assigned_staff, created_at

SELECT role, content FROM conversation_history
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.id }}'
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 30

INSERT INTO conversation_history (session_id, role, content)
VALUES
  ('{{ $json.session_id }}', 'user', '{{ $json.message_text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'),
  ('{{ $json.session_id }}', 'assistant', '{{ $json.response_text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}')

UPDATE sessions SET
  user_type = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.update_params.user_type }}' != 'unknown' THEN '{{ $json.update_params.user_type }}' ELSE user_type END,
  collected_data = '{{ $json.update_params.merged_data }}'::jsonb,
  dsgvo_consent = CASE WHEN {{ $json.update_params.dsgvo_given }} THEN true ELSE dsgvo_consent END,
  dsgvo_timestamp = CASE WHEN {{ $json.update_params.dsgvo_given }} AND dsgvo_timestamp IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE dsgvo_timestamp END,
  status = '{{ $json.update_params.new_status }}',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.update_params.session_id }}'
